about: Script camera sets for every camera id the client hard-codes and every id the statues' tactical action sets request (tools/content/build_camera_sets.py, docs/research/31-battle-camera.md): each requested id plays one of the footage's shots on the acting unit, chosen by the role of the states that request it, with a slow push-in; win shots (301-314, 101001-101028) a low chest-up push-in; the boss intro (201) a crane up to a tilted full-body shot; stage finishes (100300-100311, 350/351) a ground-level shot. flagMaintain stays false so each shot ends on its own.
